content:
Talia (PM): quick sync — i'm drafting a minimal GA "operability handbook" (SLA, observability, runbooks, support routing, pricing floor). want owners + any hard no-ships before i lock for shiproom.

Ben (Runtime): i'll own perf SLO validation and the autoscale smoke harness. suggest we publish per-model p50/p95 guidance and commit to p95 <=200ms for short chat workloads (<=32 tokens) on standard families.

Hector (SRE): i'll take monitoring, canaries and runbooks. must-haves from my side: synthetic correctness canary (sample prompts + golden checks), p99 tail latency alerts, queue-depth/backpressure alarms, and an exercised model-fallback path that routes to quantized variant under memory pressure. regional failover drill in CI is required.

Clara (FinOps): i'll own the pricing floor doc. plan: publish hosted token floor, embeddings floor, and two reserved-commit examples. enterprise discounts can be "finalizing" at GA. give me 5 biz days.

Talia (PM): proposed minimal GA acceptance checklist — react with :thumbsup: to accept or call blockers. i want any absolute "do not ship" items now.

```
GA OPERABILITY HANDBOOK (minimal)
- SLA: Dedicated 99.9% monthly uptime; Hosted 99.5% initial (owner: Talia)
- Latency guidance: publish p50/p95 per model family; infra to target p95 <=200ms for <=32-token requests (owner: Ben)
- Observability: synthetic canaries (latency + correctness), p99 tail and queue/backpressure alerts, request-level traces (owner: Hector)
- Runbooks: SEV1/SEV2 playbooks, throttling and degraded-model fallback procedures (owner: Hector)
- Autoscale & Failover: autoscale smoke harness + scripted regional failover CI job (owners: Ben/Hector)
- Docs: GA quickstart, operational expectations, migration notes for pilot customers, FAQ for pricing delta (owner: Talia)
- Support: business-hours triage + SEV1 on-call; documented escalation matrix (owner: Talia)
- Pricing: published GA floor + example commit scenarios; enterprise tiers pending (owner: Clara)
```

Ben (Runtime): blocking tech items: KV-cache cold-start regression not fully covered and autoscale burst test infra for 1k+ rps synthetic bursts. i can push smoke harness by Tue but need SRE help for failover CI hooks.

Hector (SRE): noted. i'll add CI failover job and a test that triggers fallback under memory pressure. those two must pass before we check the runbook box.

Clara (FinOps): for GA messaging we should include a short blurb: "GA pricing floor reflects pilot discounts removed; enterprise pricing in discussion" — helps set expectations. i'll draft the floor sheet and example commits by Fri.

doc-bot: Created ticket OPS-2410 (autoscale-smoke-harness) -> assignee: Ben; OPS-2411 (regional-failover-drill) -> assignee: Hector.

Talia (PM): must-not-ship items i hear: (1) untested fallback under load, (2) no regional-failover run in CI, (3) missing p99 tail alerts/backpressure alarms. confirm if i'm missing any.

Ben (Runtime): +1 on those. also prefer we don't promise 24/7 L1 support at GA — business-hours only.

Hector (SRE): agree. also require request-level tracing enabled for a sample of prod traffic before GA (privacy filters applied).

Clara (FinOps): agree on support hours. will include pricing FAQ note for pilot->GA changes.

Talia (PM): OK locking this as GA operability handbook baseline for shiproom unless anyone raises a hard blocker by EOD. will post PR with checklist and owners. thanks all.

Ben (Runtime): :thumbsup: pending autoscale smoke PR.

Hector (SRE): :thumbsup: pending failover test.

Clara (FinOps): :thumbsup: (draft incoming).
